post.caption:
The Antikythera mechanism came out of a shipwreck as a corroded lump and turned out to hold around 30 bronze gears. It is an analogue astronomical calculator: solar and lunar positions, eclipse prediction, the Olympiad cycle, and even a model of the moon's varying speed across its orbit. Gearing that sophisticated does not appear again for well over a thousand years. Progress is not a line. Knowledge gets lost, and it can stay lost.
